text:
It's most likely not a double charge. Cards are authorised at checkout and only charged when the order ships, so the amount you're seeing is probably a pending authorisation from the cancelled order. That should drop off on its own within 3-7 business days, depending on your bank, and Leafy can't release it any faster.

If you see two charges that have both fully posted (not pending), send us the order number and the last four digits of your card (never the full number or security code). Once we confirm it, the duplicate is refunded within 3 business days.
